## 中文

- 优化岗位搜索相关性排序与外包/用工证据校验：保留明确用工标签判断，核对原文证据上下文及换行/标点边界，并补充回归测试。
- 精简岗位搜索控制区，并将本地简历模板渲染器改为按需加载。
- 发布 CI 改用 Ubuntu Azure 镜像源安装 CJK 字体，提升构建稳定性。

## English

- Improved job search relevance ranking and employment/outsourcing evidence verification: preserved explicit employment labels, validated full source-sentence context across line breaks and punctuation, and added regression tests.
- Streamlined search controls and switched the local resume template renderer to on-demand loading.
- Updated release CI to install Ubuntu CJK fonts via the Azure mirror for reliability.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nimbus318/dsh-niuma-broker/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
